name: random-teleport
author: Takaro
description: Random Teleport (/rtp): players teleport to a random spot inside an area you set, either a ring around a centre point (min and max radius) or a rectangle. Blocked zones (circles or rectangles, for example trader areas or spawn) are never picked. Optional cooldown (RTP_BYPASS_COOLDOWN skips it, for example for VIPs) and currency cost, charged only after a successful teleport. Height: 7 Days to Die and DayZ move the player to ground level, so the default Y of 0 works there. Other games teleport to exactly the configured Y, so set it to a safe height for your map. For a warmup, set a delay on the rtp command in the module's command settings. Needs a game that supports teleporting players.
summary: Random Teleport (/rtp): teleport to a random spot inside a ring around a centre point or a rectangle. Blocked zones (trader areas, spawn) are skipped. Optional cooldown (VIPs can skip it) and currency cost, charged only after a successful teleport. Configurable height: 7 Days to Die and DayZ place the player on the ground, other games use the configured Y. Warmup via the command delay setting. Needs a game that supports teleporting players.

areaShape.title: Area shape
areaShape.description: circle: a ring around the centre, between the minimum and maximum radius. rectangle: anywhere between the min and max X/Z bounds.

centerX.title: Centre X
centerX.description: Circle area: X coordinate of the centre.

centerZ.title: Centre Z
centerZ.description: Circle area: Z coordinate of the centre (the second map axis; some games call it Y on the map).

minRadius.title: Minimum radius
minRadius.description: Circle area: players land at least this far from the centre. Keeps them out of the spawn area.

maxRadius.title: Maximum radius
maxRadius.description: Circle area: players land at most this far from the centre. Keep it inside your map.

y.title: Height (Y)
y.description: Height to teleport to. 7 Days to Die and DayZ move the player to ground level, so 0 works. Other games use this exact height: set a height that is safe on your map, or a height above the terrain if your game or mods prevent fall damage.

blockedZones.title: Blocked zones
blockedZones.description: Areas players never land in, for example trader areas or spawn. Circle: x, z and radius. Rectangle: minX, maxX, minZ and maxZ.

maxAttempts.title: Attempts to find a free spot
maxAttempts.description: How many random spots are tried before giving up when blocked zones cover them.

cooldown.title: Cooldown
cooldown.description: Time a player has to wait after a successful random teleport. Players with RTP_BYPASS_COOLDOWN skip it.

cost.title: Cost
cost.description: Currency a random teleport costs, charged only after it worked. 0 is free. Needs economy enabled on the server.

permissions.description: Allows a player to use rtp.
The player's random teleports do not start a cooldown, for example for VIPs.

rtp.helpText: Teleports you to a random spot in the wilderness.
